No QR for a phone: the hub is only at http://127.0.0.1:4790, which a phone can't reach. Give the hub an address your phone reaches, its tailnet or LAN address: on the hub, run `fleetd init --listen <ip>:<port> --url http://<name>:<port>` (Settings › Hub › Setup › Where the hub listens), then pair the phone again.

Pairing code: CODE  (single use, valid until TIME)
Grants:       admin on every machine
Hub address:  http://127.0.0.1:4790
Pairing link: fleetd://pair?hub=http%3A%2F%2F127.0.0.1%3A4790&code=CODE

The fleetd app on this machine pairs by itself when it opens. On a phone or another device,
enter the code and hub address above in the app, or open the link there.
